result.summary: Found a major layout defect with the bottom navigation obscured by a black bar, plus a minor styling inconsistency with favorite icons.

issues.description: Bottom navigation bar is visually broken - a thick black horizontal bar overlaps and obscures the middle icons (search and saved), leaving them barely visible and cut off.
issues.suggestion: Fix bottom navigation layout to render above the system gesture area, remove the overlapping black bar artifact and restore full visibility of all navigation icons.

issues.description: Favorite heart buttons in 'Popular right now' section have inconsistent styling - the first card shows a plain white outline with no background while the second card shows the icon inside a dark circular background.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent style for favorite buttons across all cards, with the same circular background, size and contrast.
